notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
This small update includes:

 - Control navigation. Now it's possible to navigate through all interfaces using the directional buttons of the Gamepad (controller, joystick).
 - Button remapping. Improved ergonomics when playing with a controller. We kept the keyboard mapping.
 - Inconsistency issues when accessing levels 48, 49, 50.
 - Last game achievement being called.
 - We made the game as cozy and cute as possible.

Thank you for playing Mimi the Cat - New Friends!
Keep posting your comments and suggestions in the Community Hub to help us provide an even better experience.
